title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters
hook: A 35B mixture-of-experts agent matches trillion-parameter models on long-horizon tasks — by scaling how long its trajectories run, not how big its weights are.
key_points: Agents-A1 is a 35B MoE model trained on trajectories averaging 45,000 tokens — scaling the agent horizon instead of parameter count.
Three-stage recipe: broad supervised fine-tuning, per-domain teacher models, then multi-teacher on-policy distillation into one student.
Matches or beats 1T-parameter models like Kimi-K2.6 and DeepSeek-V4-pro on long-horizon benchmarks (SEAL-0, IFBench, HiPhO).
Vocabulary-aligned distillation unifies six specialized domain teachers into a single deployable model.
content_html: Bigger models usually mean better agents — but Agents-A1 makes its case a different way: a 35-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model that reaches trillion-parameter-class performance on long-horizon tasks by training on much longer trajectories instead of growing its weights.
extra_html: The team builds a knowledge-action infrastructure connecting external knowledge, actions, observations, and verifier outcomes, producing agentic trajectories averaging 45,000 tokens. Training runs in three stages: full-domain supervised fine-tuning for broad agentic behavior, per-domain teacher models that capture specialized expertise, and finally multi-teacher domain-routed on-policy distillation with vocabulary alignment to merge six heterogeneous domains into one deployable student. The payoff: Agents-A1 leads or stays competitive with 1T-parameter models such as Kimi-K2.6 and DeepSeek-V4-pro on benchmarks like SEAL-0, IFBench, and HiPhO — evidence that lengthening and diversifying an agent's operating horizon is a viable alternative axis to raw parameter scaling. Lei Bai and 49 co-authors, arXiv 2026.

related.title: Trust Region On-Policy Distillation
related.hook: On-policy distillation breaks when teacher and student disagree too much. TrOPD only trusts the teacher where its supervision is reliable — and skips the rest.

related.title: On the Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
related.hook: On-policy distillation isn't a midpoint between fine-tuning and RL — it carves its own narrow path through parameter space, locking into a low-dimensional subspace early in training.

related.title: Switch Transformer: Scaling to Trillion-Parameter Models
related.hook: Route every token to exactly one expert instead of many - this single simplification made trillion-parameter MoE models stable enough to train at scale.

flashcards.prompt: What does 'scaling the horizon' mean here, as opposed to scaling parameters?
flashcards.back_html: Training on much longer agent trajectories (~45K tokens on average) and broader task diversity, rather than growing the model's weight count.

flashcards.prompt: How does Agents-A1 unify six different domain specialists into one deployable model?

choices.text: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation with vocabulary alignment across domain teachers
Simple weight averaging of the teacher models
Training a single model from scratch on all data at once

flashcards.explanation_html: A dedicated distillation stage transfers each domain teacher's skills into one student model, using vocabulary alignment to make knowledge transfer efficient.

flashcards.prompt: What's the headline result for Agents-A1?
flashcards.back_html: A 35B MoE agent reaches performance competitive with 1T-parameter models like Kimi-K2.6 and DeepSeek-V4-pro on several long-horizon benchmarks.
